question: Where must the vardhanī vessel be placed when Somāskanda is installed?
premises: The vardhanī vessel is placed first.
A condition is specified for Somāskanda.
The pot is positioned on the right side.
inference: If Somāskanda is present, the vardhanī vessel should be placed with the pot on the right.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of dakṣiṇeghaṭam to vardhanīṃ is compressed.
plain_english: Having placed the vardhanī vessel, if it is Somāskanda, one should place the pot on the right.
